profile.profileName: FIAF Moving Image Cataloguing (2016), Work / Manifestation+Item
profile.profileDescription: Two-level FIAF-based profile: Work, and combined Manifestation/Item.

label.name: Form of work
label.description: FIAF: form / type of work.

label.name: Genre
label.description: FIAF: genre of the work (repeatable).

label.name: Date of work
label.description: Date of production or first release of the work.

label.name: Country of production
label.description: Country or countries of production; one per repetition, ISO 3166 names or codes.

label.name: Original language
label.description: Original language(s) of the work, ISO 639 names or codes.

label.name: Original running time
label.description: Running time of the work as originally released (hh:mm:ss).

label.name: Statement of responsibility / credits
label.description: Credits as they appear on the work, transcribed.

label.name: Cast statement
label.description: Cast as transcribed or as established; use entity relationships for linked names.

label.name: Source / adaptation note
label.description: Literary, dramatic or other source on which the work is based.

label.name: Date of manifestation
label.description: Date of release, publication, printing or creation of this manifestation.

label.name: Place of manifestation
label.description: Place of release, publication or manufacture.

label.name: Release / distribution statement
label.description: Release details as transcribed (distributor, laboratory, certificate numbers).

label.name: Other identifiers
label.description: Identifiers other than the main item number.

label.name: Gauge / carrier format
label.description: FIAF: gauge or carrier type.

label.name: Colour process notes
label.description: Colour process or system, tinting/toning details.

label.name: Sound system notes
label.description: Sound system, number of channels, noise reduction.

label.name: Projection speed
label.description: e.g. 24 fps, 18 fps, 25 fps.

label.name: Extent
label.description: Length, reels and running time of this item.

label.name: Languages
label.description: Languages present in this manifestation.

label.name: Holding institution
label.description: Institution holding this item.

label.name: Condition
label.description: One entry per examination.

label.name: Cataloguing information
label.description: Record-level information.
